entities.name: Kataki
entities.description: Kami of Kamigawa made of weapons and bound in armor, protector of warriors' arms.

events.summary: Kataki comes to a village that took in a dying warrior who had offended it, seeking vengeance.
events.quote: the kami came to the village, seeking vengeance.

events.summary: A villager slays the stranger to appease the kami; Kataki claims it was robbed of vengeance and turns on the villager.
events.quote: Kataki then claimed that the villager had robbed it of its vengeance and turned on the villager.
